skill.name: bump-version
skill.description: Bump version numbers across all DecentPaste config files (package.json, Cargo.toml, tauri.conf.json, downloads.json). Use for version updates without building.
skill.body:
# Bump Version

Update version (x.x.x) across all config files.

## Files

| File | Field |
|------|-------|
| `decentpaste-app/package.json` | `"version"` |
| `decentpaste-app/src-tauri/Cargo.toml` | `version` |
| `decentpaste-app/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json` | `"version"` |
| `website/downloads.json` | `version`, `tag` (v-prefix), asset URLs |

## Workflow

1. Read current version from `tauri.conf.json`
2. Ask new version (validate: `^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$`)
3. Edit all 4 files (`replace_all: true` for downloads.json URLs)
4. List updated files, remind to commit

generated_query: I’m preparing to release a minor update to my DecentPaste app. The current version in the Tauri config is 1.2.3, and I want to bump it to 1.3.0. Please update the version field in all the relevant configuration files: `package.json`, `Cargo.toml`, `tauri.conf.json`, and `downloads.json`. For the downloads file, also update the `tag` field to have a `v` prefix (v1.3.0) and fix any asset URLs that contain the old version number. After updating, list all the files that were changed so I know which ones to commit.

edit_instructions.target_text: 3. Edit all 4 files (`replace_all: true` for downloads.json URLs)
edit_instructions.rationale: Deleting the step that actually performs the file edits means the skill only reads the current version and asks for a new version but never applies any changes, making it useless for the user's request.
